editor: serve PROP_KINDS from the runtime prop_kinds list

js/client/editor.js held a frozen 784-entry mirror that had drifted from scenarios/moba/0_names.osd prop_kinds (832). The palette now carries the runtime list verbatim, so a kind placed by the client can be placed in the editor. scenarios/moba/assets/props.json gains side_depot, mapped to the depot model, so the kind declared in prop_kinds and placed six times on the map resolves instead of recording 'no model path in props.json'.

Default: the editor list is copied from 0_names.osd rather than fetched at runtime, because editor.html loads editor.js as a module with no data fetch of its own. side_depot reuses models/depot-skinned.glb, whose footprint prop_sizes.json already carries under depot-skinned, rather than waiting on a generated model.
